headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 3-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Keider Montero earning the win. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Cincinnati Reds edged the Chicago White Sox 9-8, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins 13-1, behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs. The Seattle Mariners shut down the New York Yankees 1-0, with Logan Gilbert earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Matt Chapman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain with the San Francisco Giants. Trevor McDonald has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. James Outman is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, while Riley Greene is on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Endy Rodríguez is on the 10-day injured list with left hip inflammation, and Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list. Kyle Karros is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion.

The Boston Red Sox traded center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles on August 12, 2026, as part of the Adley Rutschman trade. The Orioles will receive Rivas and a player to be named later. The Miami Marlins traded 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.
